NatureLock Foods — Order-to-Distribution Workflow

ERP Solutions Architect NatureLock Foods 2025

Overview

Business process mapping and Odoo integration analysis for an FMCG producer: documented a 20+ touchpoint order-to-distribution workflow, closed integration gaps in a multi-entity setup and stabilised data consistency between sales, warehouse and finance.

Skills Used

Odoo Business Process Mapping Gap Analysis API Integration Multi-Entity ERP

The Challenge

NatureLock Foods sold through multiple channels while running a multi-entity Odoo setup. Each sales channel recorded orders differently, the warehouse worked from printouts, and finance had to reconcile discrepancies by hand at every close.

What I Did

Workflow documentation

Mapped every step of the order-to-distribution journey — more than 20 touchpoints — from quote to delivery note, and flagged each point where data was re-keyed or lost.

Gap analysis

Compared the mapped workflow against the existing Odoo configuration and identified integration gaps: unlinked sales channels, mismatched units of measure, and manual journals created to paper over sync failures.

Fixes & automation

Closed the gaps inside Odoo: standardised product and UoM data, automated order confirmation and delivery flows, and introduced API-based integrations so records flow between systems without re-keying.

Outcome

  • A single documented workflow replacing tribal knowledge
  • Fewer manual journals and reconciliation errors at month-end close
  • Consistent product and inventory data across entities
  • Warehouse and finance teams working from the same live records
